question: India is set to surpass ______ to become the world's most populous country by 2023, says a report by the United Nations.
solution:
The correct answer is __**China.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **China** is currently the **world's most populous country **with a population of over **1.4 billion people.**
 
• **India** is expected to surpass China's population by **2023,** with a projected population of **1.4 billion people.**
 
• This increase in population is due to a combination of factors, including a** high birth rate **and** longer life expectancy.**
 
• The increasing population in India could have significant impacts on issues such as** food security, urbanization, and environmental sustainability.**
 
• The other options mentioned in the question are also among the most populous countries in the world, but none of them are projected to** surpass China's population **in the near future.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **United States of America **is currently the** third most populous country** in the world, with a population of over **330 million people.**
 
• **Indonesia **is the** fourth most populous country** in the world, with a population of **over 270 million people.**
 
• **Pakistan** is the** fifth most populous country** in the world, with a population of over** 220 million people.**
